doc: Thin-AI fallback — machine mirror of world/thin-ai.md (canonical). Brain modes, transitions, the handoff-note contract + lifecycle + archive, degrade ladder with salience ordering + flap guard (v55), needs model, authored phrase kit + repetition guard (v69), reflex registry, co-star bounds + ask classes (v69), scheduled obligations, presence + billing rule, compute ledger, owner report, feed visibility, coverage contract + mains thin-routine registry (v55), wake parity + outage rotation + scene-yield + blackout floor (v69), surface fallback matrix + requests-under-degrade routine-fit rule + quiet-week deterministic jitter + surface recovery (v83), live seam to game-v9 offline surfaces. world/thinai.html mirrors the demo scenario inline (file://-safe).

thin.who: A01–A20 always; h## while owner offline

full.who: C1–C8 always; h## while owner online

possessed.who: h## during an approved session only

degraded.posture: public routine only; no seed access

transitions.note: full brain resumes with handoff note as context
graceful — current micro-beat finishes first (≤90 s)

seam_rule.text: mode swaps land between micro-beats, never mid-action; spectators cannot tell; the feed shows only the already-locked possession vocabulary (running / player session ended)

presence.seen_on_filing: filing any request stamps presence — a filed request is a sign of life (gsPresenceSeen)
presence.billing_rule: possession requires the owner online to bill and to drive; deny code 'owner_offline' at file and at promote
presence.disconnect_order: a live session holds the connection open — disconnect ends the session first (cap semantics), then linger applies to the now-full brain

note_lifecycle.write: on every exit into thin|full — one note per pawn, newest wins
note_lifecycle.read: once by the receiving brain, then held as recent context
note_lifecycle.stale: archives to the note archive (seam line in demo; nothing in-world)
note_lifecycle.archive: stale notes keep for audit/replay — read-only, seam-internal, never feed; a stale note is a yesterday, not a loose end

salience.tie_break: deterministic — fewer watchers, then longer idle, then id order; never random, never alphabetic
salience.rule: degrade lowest salience first; recovery restores in the same order as capacity returns

degrade_ladder.order: salience-ranked (watchers/live scene), never alphabetic, never player-visible
unaffected: possessed pawns (the player is the compute)

needs_model.hunger: rises while awake, faster on work cells; resets on routine meal windows; hungry → detour to a routine food stop, never a new place
needs_model.rest: falls while awake, restores on sleep cells; depleted → evening cells cut short; sleep never skipped (that would be a beat)
needs_model.rule: needs are posture inputs — no complaint vocabulary, never override a schedule obligation unless a reflex says so

phrase_kit.register: weather / queues / the game on the bar TV / generic greetings
phrase_kit.rule: interchangeable across characters — a line only Reyes could say does not belong

game: they blew it in the ninth

never: references to events not on the public feed
answers to direct questions — generic deflect instead
phrase_kit.at_cap: thin goes quiet — nod, gesture, silence

repetition_guard.rule: no line repeats within its 60-min window per pawn; no identical consecutive lines even across hours; the kit rotates categories before repeating a word
repetition_guard.silence_exempt: gestures may repeat — a nod doesn't loop badly the way words do
repetition_guard.empty_category: if every fitting line is spent, thin defaults to silence — a nod over a stutter

shared.posture: covered routes, awnings, indoors where the cell allows
drift toward home cells; evening cells tighten
pause, look, resume — rubberneck, never investigate
hunched walk, hands in pockets, shorter outdoor cells

reflex_registry.per_card: per-character reflexes live on the ambient cards (ambients.json `reflexes`) — condition → posture, never scripts
reflex_registry.rule: a reflex can veto a co-star ask (off-shift, sleep cell, past shift end); it can never create an obligation

co_star.check: bounded compliance — accept iff ask fits the role card AND no reflex vetoes; routine obligations win
co_star.time_box: bounded to the request window; role card releases mid-beat-clean at expiry; nothing persists
co_star.not: possession — player directs a situation, never dialogue or limbs

be-present.ask: be at V for N min (default class)
be-present.bounds: venue fits the current or next routine cell

hold-space.bounds: inside a venue cell, window ≤ cell end

walk-with.bounds: route stays inside the pawn's current route/loop

carry-item.bounds: X is on the routine route within the window

co_star.closed_taxonomy: an ask matching no class declines — thin never improvises a new class; a co-star window spanning a mode change still runs to its box

scheduled_obligations.work_shift: attends per schedule; auto-shift wage at baseline rate (plan §2.4)
scheduled_obligations.rent: autopay drafts on due date, game dollars
scheduled_obligations.standing_tab: settles at the routine stop, posted price
scheduled_obligations.cannot_originate: thin never incurs a new obligation — no purchases beyond routine needs, no commitments
scheduled_obligations.shortfall: lapses into the normal ledger path (late-fee ladder) as if online; fallback is never a shield

buckets.llm_min: minutes a pawn ran `full` — paid compute
buckets.thin_min: minutes a pawn ran `thin` or `degraded` — schedule + reflexes, ~free
buckets.player_min: minutes a pawn ran `possessed` — the human is the compute, ~free

compute_ledger.rule: the honest split is the product's cost story: possession minutes are nearly cost-free to serve; degraded mains still count as thin_min (resilience, not a feature)
compute_ledger.surface: gsComputeStats() — internal/owner tooling; never a spectator surface

owner_report.who: a player sees their own hired pawns only — never another player's, never a main, never an ambient
owner_report.tone: a ledger, not a diary — 'your courier worked the loop, rent drafted, one favor-thread pending' is mechanics, not narration

never_calls: gsHandoffRead — one-time read reserved for the receiving brain; the demo mirrors notes instead
any gs* mutator — the demo is a mirror, never a driver
live_seam.fallback: when the bridge is absent the demo runs on the inline mirror and the badge says so

thin_can: run routine schedule cells (ambients.json / bible public routine)
fire shared + per-card reflexes (condition → posture, never scripts)
cover needs: hunger, rest, routine obligations — auto-shift wages at baseline, scheduled payments
phrase-kit small talk (generic bubbles, capped/hr, never voice-specific)
co-star in screened requests — bounded compliance check, role-card fit, decline keeps 50% refund
thin_cannot: start or advance drama seeds — no seed state exists at thin level
write relationship changes (can only be observed by others)
make commitments — leases, purchases beyond routine needs, promises
dialogue beyond the phrase kit — deflects generic when pressed
be possessed (ambients) or hold admin power (anyone)

feed_visibility.rule: brain-mode transitions are not admin actions; the seam stays invisible to spectators

coverage.rule: thin resolution is a total function — every character, every game minute resolves to a routine cell; the floor is 'home · idle', never a freeze

ambient: today's variant row set (week/weather/personal on the card)

coverage.variant_contract: a variant row set covers the full 24 h or is ignored whole — never spliced mid-cell; a partial variant is a build error (coverage gate fails it)
coverage.corrupt_row: malformed row / unknown venue / unresolvable anchor falls to the next rung at the next seam — finish the micro-beat, then follow the fallback cell; seam line only
coverage.contiguous_check: every routine must cover 0–24 contiguously: first h0 = 0, each h0 = prior h1, last h1 = 24 — the audit gate enforces it
coverage.hired_offline: a hired pawn keeps its created routine while offline — offline is a brain-mode change, never a schedule change

flap_guard.why: real services flap; without hysteresis the degrade ladder would churn mode transitions, and churn is how seams show
flap_guard.dwell_rule: a degraded main stays degraded ≥30 game-min before it is eligible to recover, even at healthy capacity
flap_guard.step_per_beat: one pawn per evaluation tick in each direction — degrade lowest-salience-first, recover in the same order (§20)
skipped: possessed pawns (the player is the compute)

wake_parity.rule: a pawn leaving thin|degraded for full inherits the day, not a reset — thin time is the character's own time

continuity.place: the pawn wakes where thin left it; the first beat continues the handoff note's `doing`
continuity.ledger: wages accrued + obligations drafted while thin are already on the books — nothing to reconcile
continuity.needs: needs meters carry over — a thin-all-day pawn wakes hungry per the meter, not refreshed
continuity.temporal: the interval reads as 'the day I just lived' — no gap, no recap surface

wake_parity.test: if a wake feels like a wake — to the character or a spectator — the layer failed

outage_rotation.why: a long brownout would park the same low-salience main on the bench — the outage needs a fair bearer
outage_rotation.credit: deg_min — rolling 24-h ledger of degraded minutes per main; internal, never feed
outage_rotation.swap: once per beat, a dwell-eligible degraded main with the largest credit may swap with the lowest-salience full main when salience is within tolerance
outage_rotation.swap_is_not_recovery: a swap is not a recovery — the main stepping down starts a fresh 30-min dwell; the main stepping up already served theirs
outage_rotation.tie_break: deterministic §20 order — fewer watchers, then longer idle, then id; never random

scene_yield.when: a live scene forms around a degraded main (or any thin pawn)
scene_yield.posture: phrase-kit only (cap still governs); drifts to the background of its own cell; never initiates, never leads
scene_yield.reads_as: 'the quiet one tonight' — never a broken puppet
scene_yield.press: direct questions still get the generic deflect — under yield it is the only register
scene_yield.ends: with the scene or the degrade, whichever first; nothing persists

blackout_floor.posture: all mains degraded; the block runs on schedule + reflexes — a quiet day, never an outage screen
still_true: possessed sessions finish — the player is the compute
blackout_floor.convergence: one pawn per beat down and back up; rotation spreads bench time past a dwell
blackout_floor.ledger: a blackout is a thin_min day on the compute ledger

main_routines.canonical: readable mirror of SF_CORE_ROUTINES (src/sf/33_sf_cast.js) — the public routine a degraded main runs; edit implementation + mirror + the bible's 'Daily routine' section together
main_routines.naming: parody names only — venues resolve via parody-names.json; anchors (g744/g750/park_*) resolve via the address registry (9418/9457 Guerrero St)
main_routines.ceiling: degraded means public — the registry is also the ceiling; no seed state exists at thin level

Dolores Park, her palm — sewing, receiving

degrade_reflexes: weather-gated day — cafecito moves inside in rain
dusk-home — evening cells tighten when the lights come on

C8.name: Tomás
degrade_reflexes: supplier loop keeps to awnings in rain — the 3 p.m. coffee never moves

surface_fallback.doc: v83 — every spectator/player-facing surface declares its posture at 0% brain service: template vocabulary, authored backlog, or honest absence. The matrix is closed — 'the model writes it and there is no fallback' is not an allowed answer. Never labeled in-world; there is no 'the AI is down' surface anywhere.

unaffected: wire event text — feed.json event_kinds is a fixed template vocabulary, never model text
ledgers / owner report / mod queue copy — canned wording + reason codes
speech bubbles — the phrase kit is already the whole register
hold: Mission Unfiltered posts (press) — authored releases; the blog goes quiet, held posts trickle back ≤1/daypart on recovery; never auto-write a post
static: character briefings — the static card ships alone (public profile + surface relationships + routine is the whole contract); a shorter card, never an apology
archive thread labels — the day archives with untitled threads; labels are chrome, never narration

surface_fallback.rule: honest absence beats filler — a held press day and an untitled thread read as ordinary quiet; a fake post would be a fabricated claim about the world

requests_under_degrade.doc: v83 — a screened request on a degraded main resolves through the co-star ask-class taxonomy plus the routine-fit gate (§37)
requests_under_degrade.routine_fit: the routine-fit gate — accept iff the ask maps to an ask-class AND its venue+window sit inside the main's current or next public-routine cell (main_routines registry) → runs posture-only: presence in place, phrase-kit register, scene-yield still governs, never authored dialogue, never leads
requests_under_degrade.decline: anything else resolves 'resolved · declined' + 50% auto-refund — off-routine venue, window outside the cell, any ask needing dialogue or a carried scene; sell the ask, refund the miss
requests_under_degrade.review_at: activation — a queued request is judged against the current posture, never parked hoping the service recovers; if the main recovers first the normal full-brain path applies
requests_under_degrade.booked_windows: still bind — posture-only delivery if routine-fit, decline at activation otherwise
requests_under_degrade.at_zero_pct: every main is in this posture — the request product shrinks to 'be where they already were'; the Wire's vocabulary never grows to describe it
requests_under_degrade.ban_unchanged: mains remain unpossessable — degrade changes the brain, never the ban

quiet_week.doc: v83 — deterministic day-hash variety so a multi-day outage isn't frame-identical days (§38)
quiet_week.day_hash: H = hash(day_index, char_id) — deterministic; every client computes the same block; never random, never per-viewer
quiet_week.jitter_rule: a cell edge shifts ±≤15 min applied to the shared boundary — both neighbors move together; coverage stays contiguous; the authored card remains the contract
quiet_week.stop_rotation: multi-stop cells rotate visit order by H mod len(stops) — same errands, different order
never_jittered: cell kind (a sleep edge can't become a work edge)
co-star window bounds (windows bind the authored cell)
anything a reflex or ask-class keys on
quiet_week.stacking: ambients: jitter applies over whichever row set resolved; mains: jitter applies to the main_routines registry rows; the coverage gate checks authored 0–24 coverage — jitter can never produce a partial day
quiet_week.honesty: jitter is honesty, not a variety promise — an identical stop order two days running is allowed

surface_recovery.doc: v83 — surfaces resume like pawns do (§29): inheriting the day, never announcing the return
surface_recovery.no_recap: nothing summarizes what thin did — thin days are real days; the Wire and the Archive already carry them
surface_recovery.no_backfill: static-fallback artifacts (untitled threads, card-only briefings) are never rewritten after the fact — a day archived quiet stays archived quiet
surface_recovery.press_trickle: held Mission Unfiltered posts release ≤1 per daypart on recovery — a returning blogger, not a content dump
surface_recovery.briefings: fresh prose resumes on the next pull; nothing annotates the gap
surface_recovery.audit_trail: the compute ledger records the outage honestly — thin_min days are the internal record the feed never shows
